AI code review results below, please doublecheck

Looks good. The fix is correct: LDLM_FL_CANCEL is bit 36, so storing the mask in an int always produced 0 and the -EAGAIN retry in ll_migrate() was never triggered. Only the commit message needs attention (inline). If the patch gets refreshed, consider extending sanity test_319 (or adding a subtest) so it checks that a lease broken during `lfs migrate -m` gets retried; the existing test passed even with the bug.
